pairs.subject: visual-style-locking
pairs.evidence: pipeline/vlm-probe/motion.py:100 The motion hop hardcodes a shorter photographic suffix than the stills lane's shared NEGATIVE_STYLE, which also carries "cinema still" and "no border".

techniques.evidence: pipeline/vlm-probe/motion.py:100 Character and location are imported verbatim; the style tail is a second literal, and stills prompts never name the attached reference.
pipeline/vlm-probe/consistency.py:291 One hero file is repeated as the payload. The same function generates it and stages it; face crop and mid-grey exist only as an optional crop.
pipeline/vlm-probe/style.py:67 One joint readback becomes the recipe. No per-frame outlier drop, no owner edit, and palette_strategy is an enum rather than role-assigned colors.
pipeline/vlm-probe/style.py:146 The persisted profile has sampling and a measured palette and no proof list a lock could be derived from. The spike brief is a 20–30 shot trailer.
pipeline/vlm-probe/identity.py:280 Judgment here is a distance verdict plus a contact sheet. Context py files have no rejected-proof record.

pipeline/vlm-probe/consistency.py:14 Baseline versus reference is a real control, scored on a film floor by a separate ruler, and it is the same character rather than style transferred onto a second subject.
pipeline/vlm-probe/palette_measure.py:39 style.py stores that object beside the readback and measure_frames. survey.py:132 still downsamples the publish set without writing stride.

pairs.registryProposal: The control arm is specified only as style transfer onto a second subject. A same-subject baseline, which is the identity probe this repo actually runs, is unnamed, so a real control is easy to score as a miss.

pairs.subject: visual-style-locking
pairs.evidence: pipeline/video/render_preset_clips.py:233 The default H3 clip is prompted with only "Animate the image", so the still-to-motion hop sends the swatch and no style block.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/video/render_preset_clips.py:233 motion_author.py:61 and :143 forbid style adjectives. The Wan branch sends only the preset motion line. flux_still.py accepts whatever prompt the caller passes.
pipeline/video/render_preset_clips.py:9 The swatch is the first frame of the clip the rail already shows. This path does not assemble a multi-image style sheet.
pipeline/video/motion_author.py:63 The still reader is told to name objects and skip style, so it does not capture an attribute grammar.
pipeline/video/render_preset_clips.py:26 The gate in these files is which take ships. Presets are read from presets.ts; these files hold no style lifecycle.
pipeline/video/render_preset_clips.py:22 Failed takes stay in the ledger with checker reasons. They are clip takes, not style-sheet proofs counted against a reference window.
pipeline/video/clip_check.py:298 This is a per-clip absolute palette gate against the swatch. leonardo_reference.py:13 buys a hosted ceiling clip on the same swatch, not an unconditioned arm.
pipeline/video/motion_author.py:62 Motion text is proposed from one still. clip_check samples output frames to compute numbers and does not publish a reference strip.

pairs.registryProposal: The still-to-motion rule still requires a restated style core after saying that style words which fight the reference degrade both. It does not say what to do when a measured A/B finds a bare "Animate the image" holds the clip better than a longer instruction, which is the result this pipeline recorded.
